findings.value: A free street festival with music and dance on London's Day of the Dead, a Saturday at the end of October; the shops also stay open late on Christmas Wednesdays.

evidence.quote: bringing music, dance, flowers, costume and procession to one of East London’s best-known streets. This is a free festival.
For many years, the Columbia Road shops have stayed open for late night Christmas shopping 5-9pm every Wednesday in the lead up to 25th December.

notes: A Sunday street market, so its programme is seasonal street events rather than nights. Upcoming: London's Day of the Dead, Sat 31 Oct 2026 from 12pm, free. Past: the 2025 edition was Sat 1 Nov 2025, midday to 5pm. Christmas Wednesdays (shops open 5 to 9pm) ran each year before Christmas; carol singing is mentioned only in the 2022 and 2023 posts, so do not present singing as current. Market hours on the venue's own site: Sundays from 8am 'til 3'ish.
